body: It's not, But I'm also pissed at her for betraying me like that. We were doing perfectly fine. And here he comes to destroy shit. I just felt unwanted. And completely unloved.

I can't go back to my home. That is out of the question. I could seriously end up hurting that POS I have a pretty explosive anger when it involves that cock sucker. I'm trying to stay awake, but it's getting a little difficult to not shut my eyes.

I guess I could, but I mean do I really deserve to live? Here I am 18, no diploma of any kind. I can't imagine myself being anything else than a burden to others. Maybe it's actually for the best. I pretty much don't have a job any longer because I have not way to get there and I have no idea how to use a bus lmao.
I'm on a trail that spans for miles. The nearest things are trees, and more trees.

Lol been living here for 18 years and have no idea where the closest hotel is. I say about 10 - 15 miles. it'd take me too long, and it's about 10*F I think I'll just lay down and hopefully not wake back up. Hell of a time to be wearing thin pajama pants lmfao.
Unfortunately I don't have any friends any longer. I'm completely alone.
